data.rationale: The proposal has the same steps in the same order as the true workflow (Book > Hotels, destination, dates, Search, guests, sort/filter, reserve), but it leaves out filters and sort as parameters and hardcodes 'Price (lowest first)', so those varying inputs can't be set without changing the spec.
